page.overview:
Who is Six Brothers of Mount Mei?

The are the sworn brothers of Erlang Shen.

While Erlang Shen fought Sun Wukong, the Six Brothers kept his monkey army at bay. When Sun Wukong was knocked down by Laozi's Diamond Cutter, the Six Brothers took the chance to bind him so he couldn’t escape.
